questions.title: Tirthankara lineage
questions.stem: Which statement best represents the Jaina tirthankara tradition?

questions.stem: A siddha differs from a creator-god because a siddha

questions.title: Jiva and ajiva

questions.title: Five astikayas
questions.stem: Why are there five astikāyas although there are six dravyas?

questions.stem: In Jaina ontology, kāla primarily accounts for

questions.stem: Which relation among ākāśa, lokākāśa and alokākāśa is correct?
options: Ākāśa is space; lokākāśa is the inhabited cosmic region, while alokākāśa is empty space beyond it.
